title: Private Vacation Photoshoot with Photographer in Los Angeles
includes: Delivered via online gallery in 4-5 working days (M-F)
30-min photoshoot: 20 professionally edited photos delivered in full high resolution
1-hour photoshoot: 45 professionally edited photos delivered in full high resolution
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Get ready for an unforgettable photographic journey through LA iconic destinations! We’ll guide you on a relaxed exploration of the City most photogenic landmarks, showcasing the best Los Angeles has to offer.

Alongside our professional photography services, we’re thrilled to share insider tips to enrich your holiday experience. You can choose between a 30-minute or 1-hour photoshoot, allowing you to customise your experience to best suit your needs. Join us as we uncover LA hidden gems and well-kept secrets, all while capturing the unforgettable moments of your vacation. We can’t wait to meet you and embark on this adventure together!
